comparisons.interpretation: Vyhovsky emphasizes concern about funding sources and reform; Ledbetter defends unsolicited support. This is a campaign-framing difference, not proof of purchased votes or opposing reform positions.
Vyhovsky stresses that funding sources matter; Baruth questions the value of scrutinizing this opponent's donors. Their reform-policy positions are not assumed to be opposites.
